releases.notes:
*2026-01-25*

- Changed️: Added wrench to the wrenches tag
- Changed️: Wrenches from other mods can now be used to interact with TrafficCraft blocks
- Changed️: New curb textures
- Fixed: Crash if the same traffic sign texture is loaded too quickly on multiple signs
- Fixed: Crash when traffic sign textures are unloaded too quickly
- Fixed: The game may crash when leaving a world/server
- Fixed: House Number signs cannot be placed without a block underneath it
- Fixed: Emissive textures are not working
- Fixed: Wrong UVs for the sides of the traffic light bulbs
- Fixed: Fixed missing tag errors
- Fixed: White stripes when using fast graphics
- Fixed: Incorrect times for scheduled Streetlamps
- Fixed: Freeze when the menu of the Road Construction Tool is opened if the first position is far away from the world origin
- Now using DragonLib 3.0.19

releases.notes:
- Updated writable sign rendering
- Fixed: The back of the Town Sign is rendered on the front when the sign is facing east or west. [1.18.2, 1.20.1]
- Fixed: Rare crash when loading the traffic light schedule editor. [1.19.x, 1.20.1]
- Fixed: Only 3 instead of 4 characters can be written in the text field for the phase Id in the traffic light settings. [1.19.x, 1.20.1]
- Fixed: When using the inventory key (e.g. E) in a textbox the GUI closes.
- Fixed: If there are multiple entries in the Traffic Light Schedule with the same properties (same Phase ID, same delay, ...) and the order of one of them is changed, only the topmost element will be moved instead of the one you want to move.
- Fixed: The preview of the signs in the Pattern Catalog is not rendered. [1.19.4]
- Fixed: Some advancements do not work correctly. [1.20.1]
- Fixed: The textboxes in the Traffic Light Schedule Editor cannot be used. [1.20.1]
